mentions.name: OceanConnect
mentions.description: This web application is being assessed and transitioned into maintenance mode after its original developer left the organization. Recent work focuses on reliability and fault tolerance, improving database performance (Postgres/query plans), reducing noisy error reporting and common errors, and creating documentation and deployment systems so future maintainers can easily take over, deploy, and maintain it.
mentions.problem: The original developer left, so the application needs assessment and winding down to a stable, low-maintenance state without demanding too much attention.
mentions.source_excerpt:
Lately I’ve been working on https://oceanconnect.ca

The original developer has left our organization so I’ve been tasked with general assessment and winding it down to enter maintenance mode.
